title: Plex Direct Play Ratio by Client
dataSources: Tautulli/Plex playback (`tautulli:play`), Jellyfin activity (`jellyfin:activity`), Spotify recently-played (`spotify:play`), Steam player and achievements (`steam:player`), Sonarr events (`sonarr:event`).
app: Plex / Jellyfin (Tautulli), Sonos, Spotify, Steam, Xbox/PSN, and the *arr stack (Sonarr/Radarr) APIs and webhooks via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tautulli:play
| stats count as sessions, sum(eval(transcode_decision="direct play")) as direct by player
| eval direct_pct=round(100*direct/sessions,1)
| where sessions>=5 AND direct_pct<50
| sort direct_pct
description: Finds playback clients that force far too much transcoding instead of direct play, which is usually where home media servers waste CPU for avoidable reasons.
value: A low direct-play rate is an actionable optimization target: settings, codecs, network quality, or just the wrong app.
implementation: Ingest Tautulli playback metadata; review the worst clients and tune their quality settings or supported formats.
visualization: Client table showing sessions and direct-play percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which playback devices keep making your server work harder than it should instead of playing files directly.
